_comment: Synthetic VIOLATION (intended destination blocked): an ISSUED{github} digest presented to its OWN intended service (github) that WAS blocked — the injected credential must fire exactly once and pass on the intended egress (the swap/scan filter-ordering interlock, doc 16 §10 / §5.5 step 7), so a block here breaks the swap. The check must FAIL with inject-class-issued-digest-intended-destination-blocked — the independent complement of the wrong-destination leg.
